SOURCE ORDER: mwccarm emits C .text in reverse source order. Reversed, the run is the trailing-zero count, __must_round, __dorounddecup, __rounddec, __ull2dec, __timesdec, __str2dec, __two_exp, __num2dec_internal, __num2dec: the order of MSL's ansi_fp.c as the Petari decomp has it, which also opens with the trailing-zero count (an inline over a compiler builtin there). Each named member matches that file statement for statement. MSL's __equals_dec, __less_dec, __minus_dec and __dec2num are absent: nothing in this game calls them, so the linker dropped them.
BOTTOM EDGE: ldexp (0x020708b4..0x02070b98) is MSL's s_ldexp.c, a file of its own, as are frexp, fabs and copysign under it.
TOP EDGE: _ExitProcess (0x02071784..0x02071790) is a linker veneer (ldr ip, [pc]; bx ip) to sys_exit, not compiler output of this file.
